citations.relevance: Background for freeness of ambient Shi-Catalan cones, distinct from hereditary freeness of restrictions.
citations.title: Abe and Terao, The freeness of Shi-Catalan arrangements

correctness: Independent exact enumeration of the four deconed line families reproduces the claimed characteristic polynomial data for k=1 through 6 and the supplied closed-form counting argument proves all k>=1. In particular the coefficient S(k) is 41k^2/2 for even k and (41k^2+1)/2 for odd k, giving discriminant -k^2 or -(k^2+2). The higher-rank flat x4=...=xl=0 adds only duplicate traces, so the same rank-3 restriction occurs for l=4,5,6. Terao factorization then certifies non-freeness, while central arrangements of rank at most two are free.
limitations: The result is a witness theorem, not a flat-by-flat classification of every restriction type.
The literature search was targeted rather than exhaustive enough to establish historical priority.
originality: The nearest targeted literature located a hereditary-freeness classification for extended Shi arrangements of type A, not type B. The explicit type-B rank-3 witness and parity formula therefore appear nontrivial, but absence from this search is not used as a proof of priority; originality is assessed as moderate with that caveat.
scientific_value: A uniform closed-form obstruction is substantially more informative than isolated computational counterexamples and gives a compact certificate for every k>=1 in the requested ranks.
